Impact beyond technology01 / 03

About Me.

I’m Arnav Hooda, based in Chandigarh, India, and pursuing a B.E. in Computer Science Engineering (AI & ML) at Chandigarh University, with an expected graduation in 2027.

I work across frontend development and artificial intelligence — building web interfaces, preparing data for language systems, and exploring how useful products come together. I led dataset development for Samsung PRISM, built the Smart Gig freelance marketplace, and founded the Shopify venture Elite Wristwear.

More about my journey ＋

I enjoy turning ideas into practical solutions: understanding a problem, shaping a clear interface, and working through the details with React, Node.js, Python, and machine learning.

Clearing UPSC NDA and the Services Selection Board, with All India Rank 621 for NDA–151, strengthened my discipline and sense of responsibility. Public speaking, event hosting, and leading teams continue to shape how I collaborate.

I’m interested in Generative AI, large language models, NLP, computer vision, and intelligent automation. I keep learning, ask questions, and take ownership of the work in front of me.

04 — The project shelf

My projects.

Ingen Workspace

A proof-first staffing software product developed alongside Prabhmannat Singh and Adhiraj Dogra, founder of Ingen Workspace. The work explored how candidate evidence, recruiting workflows and hiring decisions can be made more legible through practical product thinking and data-informed experiences.

Focus areas: Statistical analysis · Data analysis · Recruiting metrics · Data visualisation · Product research

Visit website ↗

Webstell Studio

Role: Founder & Frontend Engineer

Founded Webstell Studio in September 2026. I lead frontend engineering for responsive websites and digital products, connecting client requirements with thoughtful interfaces and reliable delivery.

Focus areas: Frontend engineering · React · Responsive design · Client delivery · Entrepreneurship

Visit Webstell Studio ↗

Insight Copilot

A concept for an AI assistant that turns scattered feedback into searchable themes, priority signals and concise next steps. It is designed around human review—helping teams identify patterns without treating automation as a replacement for judgement.

Focus areas: Text analysis · Prompt design · Insight synthesis · Human-in-the-loop UX

Student Opportunity Hub

A product concept that brings campus events, opportunities, clubs and resources into one personalised starting point. The experience is structured to help students discover what matters, save it for later and move from interest to participation with less friction.

Focus areas: Product strategy · User journeys · Information architecture · Interaction design

Client Delivery Portal

A client-facing product concept for turning a project brief into a transparent delivery journey. It brings goals, milestones, feedback and approvals into one shared workspace so every stakeholder can see what is happening and what needs attention next.

Focus areas: Service design · Workflow mapping · Stakeholder UX · Product requirements

Workflow Autopilot

A workflow-builder concept for connecting prompts, tools, app requests and structured outputs in one visual sequence. The canvas makes branching logic easier to inspect, test and improve while giving teams a clearer path from an idea to a repeatable automation.

Focus areas: Systems thinking · Workflow design · API orchestration · Operational analytics

Project Insights Dashboard

A data-product dashboard concept that translates everyday project activity into a clear operational picture. It brings productivity trends, delivery progress, task status and calendar context together so teams can spot priorities, track momentum and make informed decisions at a glance.

Focus areas: Dashboard design · KPI visualisation · Data storytelling · Information hierarchy

Patient Intelligence

A healthcare data dashboard concept that brings live heart-rhythm signals, movement, stress, recovery and sleep indicators into one clinical view. The experience is designed to make personal health patterns easier to interpret while keeping priority states and next actions clearly visible.

Focus areas: Health-data visualisation · Clinical dashboard UX · Time-series insights · Information hierarchy

Campus Sync

A mobile-first campus-events concept that brings discovery, personalised feeds, reminders and calendar planning into one student-friendly experience. The interface explores clear event details and responsive scheduling flows for clubs, workshops and campus communities.

Focus areas: Mobile UX · Event discovery · Calendar flows · Information architecture

Team Workspace

A full-stack collaboration workspace concept that brings projects, tasks and decisions into one shared view. The dashboard combines clear ownership, scheduling, discussion threads and progress signals so teams can move from planning to delivery with less friction.

Focus areas: Dashboard UX · Task management · Collaboration flows · Workflow architecture
